description: This file defines the GatewayEndpointStore actor responsible for managing and resolving the current gateway endpoint configuration, including handling remote tunnels, configuration overrides, and URL construction. It also contains related utility functions for configuration resolution and URL generation.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointStore
classes.description: An actor that manages the state and resolution of the gateway control endpoint, handling various connection modes, remote tunnel management, and configuration resolution.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of GatewayEndpointState updates for subscribers.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the current connection mode and updates the state accordingly.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the current connection mode (local, remote, unconfigured) and updates the state.

methods.name: ensureRemoteControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures that the remote control tunnel is established and returns its port.

methods.name: requireConfig
methods.description: Provides the current gateway connection configuration, waiting for remote tunnels if needed.

methods.name: cancelRemoteEnsure
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing remote tunnel setup process.

methods.name: kickRemoteEnsureIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts the remote tunnel setup process if not already running.

methods.name: ensureRemoteConfig
methods.description: Ensures that the remote configuration is ready, establishing the tunnel if necessary.

methods.name: requireRemoteMode
methods.description: Throws an error if the current mode is not remote.

methods.name: resolveDirectRemoteURL
methods.description: Returns the direct remote URL if configured with a 'direct' transport; otherwise throws.

methods.name: maybeFallbackToTailnet
methods.description: Automatically falls back to a tailnet address if conditions are met, updating the state.

methods.name: localConfig
methods.description: Constructs a local gateway connection configuration based on current configuration files and environment.

methods.name: dashboardURL
methods.description: Constructs the dashboard URL for a given gateway configuration and mode.
